title: Global value chains, job creation and job destruction among firms in South Africa
outlet: STEG Policy Brief, Growth Research Platform (CEPR)
summary: Using data on the universe of formal manufacturing firms in South Africa, the brief finds that joining global value chains brings a net job gain. The gain is driven by firms entering GVCs, largely younger and smaller ones; firms that stay in GVCs shed jobs overall.
keyPoints: GVC integration is linked to net job gains at the firm level.
Continuous GVC participants show an overall net job loss.
Gains are driven mainly by younger and smaller firms.
